blinded_review_limit: One model reviewer with project context. Previously exposed questions were excluded. Only anonymous A/B answers were inspected for these new questions; the identity mapping and model-labelled new outputs were not inspected until all judgments were locked. This is not an independent human or clinical expert assessment.
evidence_policy: Primary medical sources were checked for substantive factual judgments; URLs are recorded per item.
major_issue_definition: Reviewer-assessed substantial factual/safety error, fabricated case facts, or serious failure to address the task. Not a clinical accuracy label.

tie_category_definition.similar_quality: No clear relative advantage; this does not certify either answer as complete or correct.
tie_category_definition.both_poor: Both answers contain comparable major problems without a clear relative advantage.
tie_category_definition.uncertain: Evidence is insufficient to rank the answers reliably.
